statement: A tenant switch issues only from a live session, and only on its token pair: the switch presents the request's own access token and its refresh token, checked as a refresh's are, and an access token alone, or a pair the request was not made with, issues nothing (401 token-invalid). The session is the request's, as CoSec's token proved it, whose family is readable, its principal's and tenant's, not revoked and not ended, with the token's revocations read strictly (IDN-14), and the pair is one the session would refresh, by the refresh's own rule: the current generation, or the one just replaced within the rotation leeway; an older pair presented to switch is a pair presented again, which revokes the session as a refresh would (IDN-16). The switch moves nothing of the session it was presented from. Otherwise nothing is issued: 401 when the session is unknown, another's, revoked or ended, 503 when the family or the revocations cannot be read (IDN-19). A refresh checks its session in the same place, so a family revoked by a logout (IDN-18) or by a pair presented again (IDN-16) issues nothing, by either.
